list.title: Users
list.subTitle: This section allows administrators to manage system users, assign roles, enable two-factor authentication (2FA), and control access permissions.

confirmDelete.message: Are you sure you want to delete the user "{{user}}"?

emailOrUsername.message: Provide either an email or a username

name.label: Name
name.info: The User Details section contains personal and organizational information associated with the account, including contact details and role-related metadata.

errors.email_already_exists: A user with this email already exists.

password.label: Password
password.info: At least 8 characters, including an uppercase letter, a lowercase letter, a number and a special character.

profilePicture.label: Profile picture
profilePicture.hint: PNG or JPG, up to 10 MB

crop.title: Crop profile picture
crop.instruction: Move the square to select the picture area

profilePicture.invalidType: The picture must be a PNG or JPG file (.png, .jpg, .jpeg)
profilePicture.tooLarge: The picture must be smaller than 10 MB

gravatar.title: Use Gravatar picture?
gravatar.message: A Gravatar picture is linked to this email. Do you want to use it as the profile picture?
gravatar.messageReplace: A Gravatar picture is linked to this email. Do you want to use it instead of the current profile picture? The current picture will be deleted when you save.
gravatar.notFound: Could not load a Gravatar picture for this email.
gravatar.staged: Picture loaded from Gravatar. Save the user to apply it.

create.subheader: Create a user and assign a role.
create.info: Follow the simple 3 steps to complete user creation.

update.subheader: Modify user information and save changes.

details.subheader: Basic personal information of the user. These fields define the user profile within the system.
details.info: The User Details section contains personal and organizational information associated with the account, including contact details and role-related metadata.

credentials.subheader: Sign-in credentials used to access the system. An email, a username, or both can be set — at least one is needed to sign in.
credentials.subheaderUpdate: Update the sign-in email, the username and the role assigned to this user.

role.subheader: Defines the permission level and access rights of the user within the system.

delete.cannotDeleteSelf: You can't delete your own account.

confirmDisable.title: Disable 2FA
confirmDisable.message: Are you sure you want to disable two-factor authentication for this user?

uploadProfilePicture.failed: User saved, but the profile picture upload failed. You can retry from edit.

deleteProfilePicture.failed: User saved, but removing the profile picture failed. You can retry from edit.

confirm.title: Create password reset link
confirm.message: Create a one-time link with which "{{user}}" sets a new password? Any earlier link for this user, including a pending "forgot password" link, stops working. The current password stays valid until the link is used.
confirm.sendEmail: Also send the link to the user by email
confirm.emailUnavailable: Email is not available: the server's mail settings are missing or not working. Copy the link and pass it on yourself.

dialog.title: Password reset link
dialog.description: Send this link to "{{user}}". It opens a page where they can set a new password.
dialog.descriptionEmailSent: The link was also emailed to "{{user}}". You can copy it here as well. It opens a page where they can set a new password.
dialog.expiresAt: Valid until {{expiry}}. The link works only once.
dialog.securityHint: Anyone with this link can set the password for this account. Share it only through a trusted channel. It is shown only now and cannot be displayed again.

error.ldapAccount: This user signs in via LDAP. Their password is managed in the directory and cannot be reset here.
error.emailNotFound: This user has no email address. Create the link without email and pass it on yourself.
error.emailFailed: The email could not be sent, so no link was created. Create the link without email, or check the mail settings.
error.notAvailable: Password reset links are not supported by this server version yet.
error.baseUrlMissing: The server returned an unusable link because its set-password address is not configured. Ask an administrator to set opencelium.forgot-psw.base-url to this app's /set-password page, then create the link again.
error.failed: Could not create the password reset link. Please try again.
